site_name: Land To The Rear Of16-17 The MallEalingW5 2PJ
description: Application for a minor material amendment (s73) to vary Conditions 2 (Drawings) of planning permission ref 191796VAR dated 21/06/2019 for 'Application for a Minor Material Amendment (s.73) to vary condition 2 of planning permission ref: P/2015/4989 dated: 30/06/2016 for 'construction of additional 3 floors to rear addition (creation of 5x1 bedroom flats and 1x3 bedroom flat)'. Amendment sought to provide a part infill extension to remove the approved side facing window at second floor level, and the subsequent reconfiguration of the approved internal layout'. Variation seeks further variation to the drawings approved under 191796VAR, specifically to remove the step back shown on approved plans at third and fourth floor level
